versions.changelog: Update the international Lux3D skill to the current intl.zip release. Adds multimodal image generation, model retopology, articulation, character rigging and animation retargeting support; updates global API access, supported exports, parameter guidance and concurrency documentation.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation to focus on the Global Lux3D API and its public, documented endpoints.
- Added precise instructions for using HTTP(S) URLs as inputs (img, imgs, meshUrl, modelUrl); local files must be uploaded first.
- Clarified capabilities and their corresponding endpoints (e.g., image-to-3D, text-to-3D, material transfer, four-view completion, multi-format export).
- Expanded and clarified examples for each workflow, with stricter field requirements and option listings.
- Unified option and field naming conventions for endpoints and output formats.
- Made instructions and examples easier to follow and aligned only with public API fields.

- Added support for the G1 version: a fast beta model featuring multi-view image input and new output formats (zip, glb, ply).
- Updated documentation to explain G1 options, including support for multiple image views, specific outputFormat values, default faceCount, PBR toggling, and texture size.
- Clarified effect and support of the faceCount parameter for all model versions.
- Updated references from “international” to “Global” endpoint and region.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added support for the new G1 model: fast beta, multi-view image input, and zip/glb/ply outputs.
- Updated documentation to reflect G1-specific input and output options, as well as revised field names (`imagePaths`, `outputFormat`, `enablePbr`, `textureSize`, etc.).
- Changed all endpoint and region naming from "International" to "Global"; updated API base URLs accordingly.
- Noted that the `skill-card.md` file was removed.
- Clarified face count parameter handling for Mesh and 3DGS outputs across versions.
- Updated compatibility and usage notes for text-to-3D and image-to-3D functions.

- Added documentation and support for `v3.0-standard` as the new default Lux3D version, with colored transparent material support, reduced color deviation, improved material quality, and custom face count control.
- Describes expanded five-format output support (.zip, .glb, .usdz, _obj.zip, _fbx.zip) for `v3.0-standard`.
- Documents the `face_count` parameter for image-to-3D and text-to-3D workflows (available for v2.0-preview/v3.0-standard).
- Updated all usage examples and tables to include and default to `v3.0-standard`.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.

- Added a new concurrency limit section, documenting task concurrency quotas by account type and possible API errors when limits are exceeded.
- Replaced “material transfer” with “material repaint” throughout the documentation to reflect current terminology.
- Clarified versioning details: `v2.0-preview` is now explicitly the default, with an expanded table describing model version differences, output formats, and feature support.
- Minor terminology and description updates for improved clarity.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file.

Lux3D 2.0.0  adds material transfer and version selection:

- Introduced material transfer workflow, allowing material regeneration for existing 3D models.
- Added support for selecting Lux3D API version (e.g., v2.0-preview) in all generation and CLI workflows.
- Updated usage examples and documentation to cover new features and version parameter.
- Clarified that all three workflows—image to 3D, text to 3D, and material transfer—are supported.

- Improved documentation to clarify support for international users.
- Added explicit instructions for applying for an API key.
- Documented the use of region selection via the `--region` flag and environment variable.
- Updated sample code to use the `skill.lux3d_client` import path.
- Expanded descriptions for supported text-to-3D styles in a table.
- Minor formatting and wording enhancements for better usability.

Lux3D 1.3.0 changelog:

- Updated documentation to reflect new API key registration and authentication process at https://labs.aholo3d.com/
- Changed setup instructions to use the new API root: https://api.aholo3d.com/global
- Authentication now uses the Authorization header with the API key (was previously a base64 invitation code and custom MD5 sign).
- Updated links and contact details to match new API provider information.
- Cleaned up legacy details for improved clarity and accuracy.
Add text-to-3D workflow and update skill documentation
Security enhancements: API key validation, input/output validation, secure requests with retry logic, timeout protection, and comprehensive documentation
Remove redundant lux3dToken parameter, add error handling, split code into lux3d_client.py

Lux3D 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Introduces the ability to generate 3D models from 2D images using Lux3D.
- Provides detailed setup and usage instructions, including API key application process.
- Includes example Python code for individual image-to-3D conversion.
- Adds optional batch 3D asset generation capability.
- Ensures QIZHEN Engine compatibility for generated PBR models.
